title: Fourier regularity of odd majority
statement: For each integer $m\ge 0$, let $n=2m+1$ and consider the majority function on $\{\pm1\}^n$, which outputs the sign of the sum of its coordinates (with nonnegative sums assigned $+1$). Every nonempty-set Fourier coefficient of this function has absolute value at most $1/\sqrt{n}$.
